Zombie Crasherzby un1v3rsedragon

Zombie Crasherz is pure vehicular slaughter on a countdown. You’re behind the wheel of a battered machine tearing through abandoned city streets as the undead swarm the asphalt. Every zombie you smear across your hood is a point. The road fills thicker the longer you survive. You have exactly three minutes to rack up a kill count that clears the stage minimum—or you watch the city stay lost. Toxic zombies are the real threat. Hit one and your car takes visible damage, the health bar drops, and a red haze bleeds across the edges of your vision. Dodge them. Or risk a one-shot gun pickup you’ve scavenged along the way and make the bullet count. Miss and you’re back to pure steel and speed. The stages escalate. Early runs are open-road carnage. Starting at stage five, the streets turn vicious: concrete barriers, sudden cracks, and bombs you have to thread at full speed while the horde thickens around you. Clear a stage and it’s permanently unlocked—come back anytime and chase a higher score. Clear it by fifty or more over the minimum and steering wheels start appearing. Collect them to unlock new cars (fifteen color options once unlocked, five to start) and load extra ammo into future gun pickups. At the end of every successful run, an epic cutscene shows the city brightening, streets clearing, light returning. Fail—whether your car is torn apart or the timer runs out—and the opposite plays: zombies swarm the vehicle, climbing the hood, tearing at the doors, overtaking everything as the screen goes dark. On-screen you always see the essentials: car health, total steering wheels collected, current zombie kills versus the minimum needed, and the three-minute timer counting down. Leaderboards track highest points, most stages cleared, and the names of the drivers who refused to stop. One city at a time. One red-hazed run at a time. Hit them all before the clock dies. Zombie Crasherz — the road never stays clear for long.

Zone Wars: Battle for Steel Cityby RJ_The_Creator

Battle for Steel City: Zone Wars is a fast-paced, competitive 5v5 multiplayer shooter set in the gritty, cyberpunk-inspired lower districts of Steel City. Players choose between two rival factions—NFF (Neo Freedom Fighters) or BZF (Bottom Zone Fighters)—and engage in strategic battles to dominate the battlefield. The game features symmetrical maps with three key paths, providing balanced opportunities for both teams to outmaneuver and outthink their opponents. Players utilize a versatile three-weapon load-out (pistol, shotgun, and rifle) to adapt to close, mid, or long-range combat, encouraging tactical decision-making and teamwork. Victory depends on coordination, accuracy, and seizing critical high points on the map. An in-depth ranking system, unlock-able weapon skins, and wearable cosmetics keep players engaged as they climb the leaderboard. Whether teaming up with friends or competing against them, Zone Wars offers intense, immersive gameplay that blends fast action with strategic depth, delivering endless replay-ability in the heart of Steel City's war-torn zones. Key Features: Team-Based Gameplay: 5v5 matches with two opposing factions battling for control. Symmetrical Maps: Balanced layouts with three distinct paths and strategic high points. Tactical Load-outs: Players equip a pistol, shotgun, and rifle to suit their play-style and tactical needs. Progression and Customization: Unlock new weapon skins, wearables, and rank up as you dominate the competition. Immersive Setting: Set in the dark, futuristic world of Steel City, where war rages between factions over scarce resources.
